title: Both in the Carrier
hook: Both cats are boxed. A person is in the crosswalk.
scene: Overcast midday on a two-lane downtown street. The Menace is in the right travel lane, moving. The carrier sits on the true floor to the right of the tunnel — not on the seat base — door latched, a readable strap around the box and the seat post. Gracie and Mya are both inside — orange with a cream chest, brown with a dark stripe — visible through the grate. Ahead through the mesh, a person in a dark coat is already in the marked crosswalk in this same lane, one shoe on the white paint. The full-width nose plow points at that person. The boot sole overlaps the brake pad with a visible gap. The cats are cargo in a closed box. The person in the paint is the decision.
debrief: Animals ride in a closed, strapped carrier on the floor. The person in the crosswalk is the decision you can see because the load stayed down.

source.teaching_target: Pets ride in a closed strapped carrier on the floor; a person already in the marked crosswalk stays visible ahead.

image_brief.camera_pose: Camera is inside the Menace cabin, over the wheel, looking forward through the windshield. Gauges bottom-left, coarse panel mesh across the glass, downtown street through the grid. Overcast midday daylight. Cabin matches the promoted Menace plate (flat painted dash, single nacelle, unbranded wheel). Brake-81 is POSTURE only: sole of the work boot directly above the brake pad, overlapping in frame, visible gap between sole and pad. Do not copy brake-81's moulded dark Encore dash. Y4 take 1 is Encore glass/cage/roofline only — not this cabin.
